title: Binance Futures Updates Taker Program (2025-01-28)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures is updating the Taker Program. Effective from  2025-01-28 00:00 (UTC) , eligible users may enjoy a taker fee discount of  up to 20%  on  eligible USDT-margined and USDC-margined perpetual and delivery contracts . Users who reach a  total Futures trading volume of 100,000,000 USDT equivalent  in the last 30 days may  submit an application  for the Taker Program at any time, and be assessed for eligibility in the Program’s weekly review. Users who have applied for the  previous Taker Program  are  not  required to resubmit the form, and will be assessed for eligibility automatically. The taker fee discount will be effective from  the following Tuesday   at 00:00 (UTC)  after the weekly review.  Users may qualify for  higher taker fee discounts  on eligible USDⓈ-margined perpetual and delivery contracts, based on their  weekly taker volume share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs , or  weekly taker volume share that exclude BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs  on  USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts   in the previous week (i.e., from Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC) . Refer to the table below for more details: Fee Tier Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share on BTC, ETH, and BNB Pairs Or Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share (Excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB  Pairs) Taker Fee Discount on USDT-M and USDC-M Perpetual and Delivery Contracts 1 0.2% ≤ X < 0.4% Or 0.2% ≤ X < 0.4% 10% 2 0.4% ≤ X < 1.2% Or 0.4% ≤ X < 1.2% 15% 3 X ≥ 1.2% Or X ≥ 1.2% 20% Please Note: Users may qualify for a higher fee tier and corresponding taker fee discount on eligible USDT-margined and USDC-margined perpetual and delivery contracts, so long as they fulfill the requirements of either the  weekly taker volume share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs, or the weekly taker volume share excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts for the respective fee tier .  Assuming user A reaches a 2% weekly taker volume share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs, and a 0.4% weekly taker volume share excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts from Monday 2025-01-20 00:00 (UTC) to Sunday 2025-01-26 23:59 (UTC).  User A will qualify for Fee Tier 3 as per their weekly USDⓈ-M Futures taker volume share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs.  Therefore, user A will enjoy 20% off taker fees for trades on USDT-margined and USDC-margined perpetual and delivery contracts starting from Tuesday 2025-01-28 00:00 (UTC) to Monday 2025-02-03 23:59 (UTC) (i.e., during the Validity Period). As the taker fee discounts from the updated Program will be effective from Tuesday 2025-01-28 00:00 (UTC) only, users may still enjoy the respective taker fee discounts from the  previous Taker Program  till  Monday 2025-01-27 23:59 (UTC) , if they have applied for the Program previously and meet the corresponding requirements. Enrol in the Taker Program Now! Terms & Conditions: Users’ weekly taker volume share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs, and weekly taker volume share excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts will be reviewed on a weekly basis (i.e.,  from Monday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 23:59 UTC ). Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures taker volume share on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs is defined by the user's weekly taker transaction volume on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs divided by the weekly total taker transaction volume on BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs in the USDⓈ-M market  from Monday 00:00 (UTC) to Sunday 23:59 (UTC) . Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures taker volume share excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs is defined by the user's weekly taker transaction volume excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs divided by the weekly total taker transaction volume excluding BTC, ETH, and BNB pairs in the USDⓈ-M market  from Monday 00:00 (UTC) to Sunday 23:59 (UTC) . Any fee tier adjustments will be automatically updated on  the following Tuesday at 00:00 (UTC)  based on the aforementioned criteria. Users will be removed from the Taker Program if they do not meet the minimum criteria for  three consecutive weeks . Binance Futures will consider reapplications to the Taker Program after 3 calendar months. The taker fee discount will be directly applied to each taker trade. The taker fee discounts are applied  on top of  the  BNB fee discount  and  VIP tier rates . Binance Futures will provide daily and weekly reports to participating users via email. Binance reserves the right to amend or terminate this Program at its sole discretion. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For more information and further inquiries, please email  futures-business@binance.com  or speak directly with your sales and key account coverage teams. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-10
